subject: a dark navy blue Swedish estate car (station wagon) from the 2000s, seen exactly from the side, the nose pointing LEFT: long flat roof with black roof rails, four side windows in a row with black window pillars, chrome door handles, silver five-spoke wheels with black tyres, a light amber headlamp at the left nose and a red tail lamp at the right end, a black bumper strip
part_map: the big mid grey shape is the car body (exactly that length and height; the bonnet low on the left, the windscreen sloping up, the long roof to the square rear on the right), the light grey band is the glass of the side windows, the two dark grey circles are the wheels (exactly that size and place), the small pale square at the left is the headlamp.
size_sentence: the car is about four and a half dogs long and its roof is about twice as high as the dog's head. It is a real full-size family car, not a toy.
